objectives.objective_text: ટેકમાં કંકુ-કેસર છાંટીને કંકોતરી મોકલવાનું કેમ કહ્યું છે અને પહેલી કડીમાં બેનીબાને નાગરવેલના છોડ સાથે કેમ સરખાવી છે તે કડીની પંક્તિઓ પરથી કહેવું.
કંકોતરી પહેલાં કાકાને ને પછી બીજી કંકોતરી મામાને કેમ મોકલાય છે, અને મામા હોંશે મોસાળું લઈને કેમ આવે છે તે કડી પરથી તારવવું.
ત્રીજી કંકોતરી માસીને મોકલાય ત્યારે ગીત ફરી એ જ ટેક પર કેમ પાછું આવે છે અને માસી હોંશે ભાણેજ પરણાવવાની વાત કેમ કરે છે તે કહેવું.

notes: Agent 5 attached original_chunk, modified_chunk, word_count, key_terms and the four content-type fields to all three topics. Ids, names, objectives, structure, difficulty, depends_on and the concept layer are passed through from 02_structure.json untouched; only concepts[].key_terms (empty in the frozen structure) was filled, mirroring the topic-level list, since every topic here carries exactly one concept.

Context-routing note, disclosed rather than guessed: this run's READ THESE list gave five reference docs (no_hallucination_policy.md, global_content_rules.md, author.md, gujarati_verbatim.md, shabd_gloss.md) but not profiles/genres/lok_geet.md, even though agents/05_verbatim_attachment.md's own frontmatter lists the active genre profile(s) under profiles/genres/ as a required input. lok_geet.md exists locally (named in 01_meta.json's and 02_structure.json's active_genre_profiles) and was read in full -- the same gap Agent 1 and Agent 2 both hit and disclosed on this same chapter. Its media prior (one image per kadi or round) and its never-name-an-author hard gate for this authorless lokgeet directly shaped the content-type and key_terms decisions below.

Source of the verbatim: 00_chapter_normalized.md's tek/kadi block, sliced out exactly, then verified line by line against _renders/page-1.png at full resolution -- the whole poem is printed on printed page 1 in a single centred column. Every one of the 17 printed poem lines was re-read against the render. NO TRANSCRIPTION DEFECT FOUND: 00_chapter_normalized.md matches the render on every line, including ળ versus લ (રોપિયો, ભાણેજ), શ/ષ/સ (હોંશે, ભત્રીજ), and the presence or absence of અનુસ્વાર (કંકોતરી, બેનીબાનાં, જગમાં). The શબ્દાર્થ box re-read on printed page 2 also matches 00_chapter_normalized.md's [[શબ્દાર્થ]] transcription exactly.

Round-wise cut, per 02_structure.json and lok_geet.md: M1.S1.T1's original_chunk holds the tek's FIRST full printing (2 lines) plus kadi 1 (5 lines, the benibaa-identification plus kaka round) -- 7 lines, blank line kept between the two printed stanzas as the page sets them. M1.S1.T2 holds the tek's second printing (2 lines, printed in full again on the page, not shorthand) plus kadi 2 (2 lines) -- the mama round. M1.S1.T3 holds the tek's third printing plus kadi 3 (2 lines, the masi round) plus the tek's fourth and closing printing (2 lines, ending in the page's own full stop rather than a comma) -- the poem's final round and close. All four tek occurrences are word-for-word identical, as 01_meta.json's tek_note already established, so nothing was normalised or shortened between occurrences: each is copied in full exactly as printed, because the page prints it in full each time (there is no shorthand marker like '- એક જ.' or 'આવ્યો...' anywhere in this chapter's poem).

The two line-internal echo phrases 'માણેકથંભ રોપિયો...' and '...કંકોતરી...' are kept exactly where and how the page prints them, inline at the end of their own kadi lines -- never pulled out as a separate refrain and never expanded, per 01_meta.json's structure_inventory.tek_note and lok_geet.md's sound-as-content guidance.

modified_chunk is a plain 'shu thai rahyu chhe' restatement of two to three sentences with the hardest words glossed inline -- seed material for Agent 12, not the teaching.
